def timestamp(cls):
        """The getter for the attribute `timestamp`.

        Returns
        -------
        str
            Bitstream download timestamp.

        """
        if hasattr(Device.active_device, "timestamp"):
            return Device.active_device.timestamp
        
        if global_state_file_exists():
            gs = load_global_state()
            return gs.timestamp
